snippet.title: Scratching Shadows – Teaser
snippet.description:
This is an unfinished project that was originally meant to be part of a Critical Reflex game collab (CRBroadcast), but it ended up not moving forward. The idea was to play through different found-footage style games, each with its own concept, forming a larger narrative that could have connections between them.

This was also the first project where we aimed for a more realistic look and started working with assets.


ABOUT

In Scratching Shadows, you play as a hungry cat wearing a small body camera, exploring an abandoned motel in search of food. As you wander around, you’ll also end up chasing a rat through the environment.

https://chicogames.itch.io/scratching-shadows
